description: Analyze WHO owns the space in a directory (read-only, deletes nothing). For each large subdirectory, collects evidence: size, file count, last-write age, whether it is referenced by PATH, has a running process, appears in the installed-programs registry, and matches a known-software signature (e.g. trading-app config dirs, orphaned mover archives). Use the evidence to reason about what is safe to delete/migrate, then ALWAYS let the user decide — never delete based on this analysis alone. Windows only.

path.description: Directory or drive root to analyze, e.g. "C:\" or "D:\Software"

top.description: Max entries to return, largest first

name: analyze_disk
